query: WITH updated AS (UPDATE profiles SET name = $2, display_name = $3, email = $4 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id) INSERT INTO profile_events (id, recorded_at, sequence, event_type, event) SELECT updated.id, COALESCE($5, NOW()), ROW_NUMBER() OVER () + $6, unnested.event_type, unnested.event FROM updated CROSS JOIN UNNEST($7::TEXT[], $8::JSONB[]) AS unnested(event_type, event) RETURNING recorded_at
